name: Returning Home
summary: A summons reaches wandering night elf priests in Dun Morogh, calling them back to Darnassus. Maxan Anvol, the dwarven priest trainer, directs them to report to Priestess Alathea at the Temple of the Moon.

sections.title: A Summons Across the Sea
sections.body: In Kharanos, Maxan Anvol takes note of the night elf's fortitude amid Dun Morogh's bitter cold, far from Teldrassil's serene forests. The dwarven priest trainer brings urgent word: a priestess of Elune passed through looking for the elf, carrying orders from Darnassus that demand an immediate return.

sections.title: The Temple of the Moon
sections.body: The road leads across the sea to the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus, among Teldrassil's sacred boughs. Priestess Alathea welcomes the traveler back to the Sisterhood of Elune, relieved to see another devotee return unscathed from foreign lands. She swiftly prepares the priest for the next rites of devotion, beginning with the Stars of Elune.

faq.q: Who sends me on this quest?
faq.answer: Maxan Anvol, the dwarven priest trainer in Kharanos, delivers the message. He says another night elf priestess recently passed through Dun Morogh seeking you.

faq.q: Where do I need to go to complete it?
faq.answer: Return to Darnassus, on Teldrassil in northern Kalimdor. Priestess Alathea awaits inside the Temple of the Moon.

faq.q: Why is the Temple of the Moon calling me back?
faq.answer: Priestess Alathea and High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind monitor the development of young initiates. Alathea wants to confirm your safety, hear of your travels under Elune's grace, and begin your next stage of spiritual training with the Stars of Elune.

faq.q: What happens after speaking with Priestess Alathea?
faq.answer: When you report your return, Priestess Alathea offers Stars of Elune, continuing your foundational rites as a Kaldorei priest.

faq.q: Why would a night elf be in Dun Morogh at level 10?
faq.answer: Night elf adventurers can sail from Darkshore to Menethil Harbor in the Eastern Kingdoms. There, they explore Alliance lands or adventure alongside dwarf and gnome comrades.

faq.q: Is this quest available to other races?
faq.answer: No. This is for night elf priests training in dwarven lands, and it directs them back to their cultural and spiritual home in Darnassus.

angles.text: As a priest, you return from distant lands to the leadership of the Sisterhood of Elune, keeping your devotion to the Moon Goddess steadfast.
As a Kaldorei braving Dun Morogh's frigid winds, you receive a welcome call back to Teldrassil's familiar sanctuaries and ancestral forests.
